title: Keep task-sync project-selection and attribution refusal reasons
outcome: Keep task-sync project-selection and attribution refusal reasons
acceptance: CLI task-sync settings refusals preserve a bounded useful project/home or attribution reason, including the missing-home remedy pass --home or set ENGRAM_HOME.
JSON and text fixtures distinguish missing home, invalid marker and invalid attribution while preserving the engram-task-sync-error-v1 refusal contract and absence of settings writes.
